description: This file provides utility functions for reading files and collecting plugin source information from a directory structure, specifically targeting plugin manifests and package.json files for extensions within a project.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the content of a file synchronously if it exists; returns null if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects plugin source information from the 'extensions' directory, including manifest data and optionally package.json data, filtering based on the existence of manifest files and optional package.json requirement.
